content.text: Two wakings at 19 months is really common. Here's one thing to try tonight. When Remy wakes, pause a minute before going in, and keep the visit short and boring. Use low light, a quiet word or two, a pat, and no picking up or feeding. Doing it the same way every time is what helps most. Over a week or two, toddlers usually learn that waking up isn't worth the effort.
